PolyGlotty Terms and Rules

Last updated: 2026-05-27

These rules define what PolyGlotty does, what it does not promise, and which situations are outside PolyGlotty's control.

1. Service Scope

PolyGlotty is a Telegram WebApp for learning English. It includes a course, flashcards, tests, a learning path, progress tracking, practice tasks, and the subscription-based ALEX AI assistant.

PolyGlotty is an educational product. It is not an official school, university, exam center, legal advisor, medical service, financial advisor, or government institution. Certificates, levels, XP, streaks, badges, and achievements show progress inside the product and are not official accredited qualifications.

2. Learning Results Are Not Guaranteed

PolyGlotty helps users study consistently, but it cannot guarantee admission, employment, exam scores, fluent speaking within a fixed period, correction of every possible mistake, or the same progress speed for every user.

3. AI Can Be Wrong

ALEX can explain grammar, check texts, generate examples, and help with practice. AI models can still make mistakes, miss context, oversimplify, hallucinate, or provide inaccurate wording. Important information should be verified. AI replies are not legal, medical, financial, immigration, tax, or other professional advice.

4. Payments and Subscriptions

Digital subscriptions are paid through Telegram Stars. Access is activated after a successful payment and linked to the user's Telegram ID. If payment succeeded but access did not appear, contact payment support through /paysupport with the selected plan, payment time, screenshot, and Telegram ID if known.

Refunds, disputed payments, fees, regional restrictions, taxes, and payment availability are governed by Telegram Stars, Telegram, App Store, Google Play, banks, and other payment providers.

5. Third-Party Services and Availability

PolyGlotty does not control Telegram, Telegram WebView, Telegram Stars, App Store, Google Play, banks, Anthropic, AI models, TTS/STT providers, Railway, DNS, CDN, internet connection, devices, operating systems, browser updates, or regional restrictions. These may temporarily affect product features.

6. Limits, Models, Pricing, and Sustainability

Limits, models, quota point costs, prices, plan contents, XP rewards, and feature access may change to keep the service sustainable, prevent abuse, handle load, adapt to provider pricing, and keep subscriptions fair for paying users.

7. Fair Use and Abuse Prevention

Users must not bypass limits, create fake accounts, automate requests, overload the server, scrape product content, attempt to receive paid access without payment, interfere with APIs or payments, send spam or harmful content, impersonate PolyGlotty, or present internal progress certificates as official accredited documents.

8. User Content and Safety

Users are responsible for the text, voice, files, and materials they send. Do not send passwords, bank card details, documents, private conversations, medical records, addresses, third-party personal data, confidential business information, or anything you are not allowed to share.

9. Privacy and Data Deletion

PolyGlotty stores data required for learning and subscriptions, including Telegram ID, name or username, language, level, XP, streak, progress, subscription status, flashcards, mistakes, settings, and learning context. PolyGlotty does not sell personal data. To request deletion, contact /support and include your Telegram ID.

10. Support

PolyGlotty Support tries to respond quickly, but requests are handled in queue and instant replies are not guaranteed. App questions: /support. Payment questions: /paysupport.

11. Changes to These Rules

PolyGlotty may update these rules, prices, limits, features, and plan contents. By continuing to use PolyGlotty or buying a subscription, the user agrees to the current version of these rules.
